top_signals.title: Treasuries Gain as Confidence in Warsh Grows, Trump Threatens EU Tariffs
top_signals.summary: US equity futures and Treasuries advance a day after the Federal Reserve raised interest rates boosting confidence in Chair Kevin Warsh's commitment to fight inflation. President Trump threatens he will put very serious tariffs on the EU if he thinks its push for closer ties with Canada is harmful to the US. Jane Foley of Rabobank joins "Bloomberg Brief" to discuss the market reaction to the Fed's decision. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Risk of Midterm ‘Blue Wave’ Leaves Defense Stocks Out of Favor
top_signals.summary: After two years of breakneck gains, shares of military contractors have hit a wall this year. Traders are expecting the pain to deepen further as they position for protracted negotiations and funding delays should Democrats take control of one or both houses of Congress following the midterm elections.

top_signals.title: US Jobless Claims Fall to Lowest Level Since July at 196,000
top_signals.summary: Applications for US unemployment benefits decreased by 10,000 to 196,000 in the week ended Sep. 12, according to Labor Department data released Thursday. Claims fell last week to the lowest level since July, adding to signals of labor market stability. Michael McKee reports on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)
